chapter: Forming the band in New York
title: Dud Bascomb and Haywood Henry at 'Bama State; the fire escape
summary: Dud was his roommate and Haywood a friend and sports companion; they climbed the dorm fire escape after jam sessions.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: I'd like to go back now. There's some other things, of course, I want to ask you about that period. But, I'd like to go back before we get too far away to 'Bama State and to as far as you can remember. If you can sort of reminisce in reference to, you know, each one of the musicians that are there. Like, what they were like, where they were coming from, what they were doing, and how they became a part of the musical scene. You know, people like Haywood and Dud and so on. Can you give us some idea of how you met them and how you begin to grow together, and how you hooked up, and what impressions you had of them.
Well, I'll go with Dud first because he stayed close with me in Birmingham.

Well, Dud and I went to 'Bama State the same year. So, we were actually roommates, Dud and myself. We was roommates together. So, we was very close. That's the reason why during all the arranging that had to be made, Dud and myself, Dud had to be on that somewhere, and he come out to be a terrific man, you know.

And so, Haywood was also at 'Bama State at the same time. And so, we met each other there before he left to come to New York later. But, I didn't know Haywood in Birmingham. I don't remember knowing him in Birmingham. If I did, he told me he knew me. But, I didn't know him too much, but I knew him very well at 'Bama State.

We had, like I said, we had a lot of fun in sports together besides the music part. So, we used to go here and there in Montgomery and that's for little sessions with the other hometown musicians around there, and play and jam.
And then, coming back to the

dormitory, the dormitory doors were locked at 11:00. So, all the way from the jam, we had to go up the fire escape. So, we went through the fire escape. So, the dean got tired of us coming up the fire escape. He knew where we were. So, he just left the door opened for us. So, he was tired of that, you know, although they gave us a break on account of us going out travelling with the band for the school.
